description.zh: 当你不确定、需要用户确认或补充信息时，弹出对话框向用户提问并等待回答。可给 options 让用户从选项中选，或 allow_text 让用户自由输入；不要用它替代你能自己完成的判断。
description.en: When you're unsure or need the user to confirm or supply information, pop up a dialog to ask and wait for the answer. Provide options for a multiple-choice pick, or allow_text for free input; don't use it to offload judgements you can make yourself.

options.description: 可选项列表（让用户从中选择，可选）

allow_text.description: 是否允许用户自由输入文字（无选项时默认允许）

multi_select.description: 是否允许多选（用户可勾选多个选项，并可在「其他」里补充）

question.description: the question to ask the user

options.description: list of choices for the user to pick from (optional)

allow_text.description: whether to allow free-text input (default on when there are no options)

multi_select.description: whether to allow multi-select (user can check several options and add their own under "Other")
